verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workers AI explicitly delivers this story: 'Run AI inference globally with one API call... no GPUs to manage, no capacity planning' with a 50+ model catalog, one-line AI Gateway integration, and serverless scaling without managing infrastructure. Community evidence corroborates general Workers platform ease-of-use and global reach, though no independent hands-on review specifically validates Workers AI inference latency/scale claims. missing for 10: independent benchmark or hands-on report confirming global inference performance/capacity claims, and detail on model selection/latency tradeoffs.
